app.name: Studio Schedule
app.tagline: Classes and bookings for your dance school

demo.label: Demo mode
demo.banner: Demo mode: this app runs entirely in your browser (Go compiled to WebAssembly) with an in-memory database. Nothing is stored on a server; your changes are kept in this browser until you reset the demo, which also moves the sample dates to today.
demo.learnMoreLabel: Learn more about the live demo (opens GitHub in a new tab)

mailbox.title: Demo mailbox
mailbox.description: This demo sends no real email. The mails the app would send are listed here, newest first.

reset.title: Reset the demo?
reset.description: This deletes everything you changed in this demo (edits, bookings, registered accounts and mails) and signs you out. The demo starts again with its sample data.

elsewhere.title: The demo is open in another tab
elsewhere.description: The demo runs in one tab at a time, so your changes are saved in one place. Use it here instead? The other tab saves its changes and shows this notice.

notices.saveFailed: Your changes to the demo cannot be saved in this browser (for example in a private window), so a reload starts the demo afresh.
notices.resetFailed: The demo could not be reset: its saved data could not be deleted. Please try again.

backend.startingHint: The backend is being loaded into your browser. This usually takes just a moment.
backend.crashedDescription: The in-browser backend stopped unexpectedly. Reload the page to start it again with your changes, or reset the demo to start over with the sample data.

home.title: Welcome
home.intro: Plan classes, publish the timetable and let students book their spot.

status.title: System status
status.loadError: Could not load data from the backend.

schedule.title: Next lessons
schedule.description: What is on in the coming days.
schedule.empty: No lessons in the next 7 days.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.
